description: Modal provides token-priced Shared Endpoints and customer-owned, usage-priced dedicated inference deployments. Endpoint hostnames, rather than a globally fixed model slug, are used as API model IDs.
residency_notes: Inference endpoints do not store request or response payloads. Endpoint routing can be selected from us-west, us-east, ca-central, eu-west, or ap-south; compute placement is independently selectable. Modal's broader Function product has different routing and retention behavior and is not represented as a model API route here.
regional_pricing_notes: Explicit broad compute regions cost 1.5x base rates and narrow regions cost 1.75x. Shared Endpoint model pages publish token prices separately.
prompt_training_notes: Modal's terms state that it will not train AI models using Customer Data without prior written consent. Its security guide states that inference endpoint request and response payloads are not stored.

sources.notes: Shared Endpoint base URL, proxy-token authentication, token-scoped model discovery, and endpoint-hostname model IDs.
Public model library; model pages distinguish Shared Endpoint offers from customer-owned dedicated deployments.
Dedicated Endpoint compute rates, plan limits, and regional multipliers.
Inference endpoint zero-data-retention and product-specific retention details.

verification.notes: Reconciled Shared Endpoint offers with Modal's customer-owned Endpoint lifecycle. Routing stays disabled because the API model ID is a workspace endpoint hostname discovered per proxy token, not a fixed public repository slug.
